---
name: claim-ledger
description: Build or review an Autor Ventura Claim Ledger for material verifiable assertions with source date and confidence traceability. Use when journalism academic edital or other evidence-sensitive content contains factual claims. Do not use when material is purely fictional or subjective and has no factual verification need.
---

# Claim ledger

- Extract material claims that affect the reader's understanding or decision.
- Classify each as fact allegation analysis opinion or unresolved assertion when applicable.
- Attach only sources actually provided or verified by the workflow.
- Record source date and confidence using existing repository conventions.
- Mark unsupported claims for removal qualification or further research.
- Verify names numbers dates and citations before final publication.
- Never fabricate a source DOI quote interview document or confidence signal.
